name: fiducial_grasp_onsite_20261119_envelope
tolerance_basis: Measured gripper envelope, 2026-11-19: the opening axis passes [-6, +12] mm (centre +3 mm, ±9 mm about the true cube centre), x and z pass at ±9 mm with no failure. 6 mm is the conservative worst-side value; the 2 deg rotation tolerance is still the provisional protocol gate.

sources.notes: Held-out final base error from the 14-pose bus-servo hand-eye dataset (3.29 mm); the same dataset reports 3.41 mm leave-one-out std. Treated as a bound, not a Gaussian sigma.
Held-out final base rotation error (0.43 deg); treated as a bound.
Worst of 15/15 semi-synthetic poses on real camera frames; the marker was composited, not physically present. This is a relative-pose detection error.
Worst semi-synthetic rotation error (0.53 deg); treated as a bound.
30 visits to the grasp pose [0, -0.6618, -1.8012, -0.3917, 0], AprilTag-observed. Radial RMS 0.449 mm, radial max 1.017 mm; the measured joints repeat to 0-1 pulse.
Max geodesic deviation of the tag frame from the mean over the same 30 visits; mean 0.446 deg.
15 forward + 15 reverse visits to the same pose from joint4 +/-0.1 rad. Hysteresis vector (-0.971, -0.064, -0.549) mm, magnitude 1.117 mm; joint4 settles 10 pulses apart.

Still not isolated. The 24-pair trial measured the end-to-end placement error: 3.31 mm mean (SD 1.48) for the corrected method, 4.97 mm (SD 2.87) for the uncorrected one; that value also carries the residual constant-correction error and release dynamics.
No real grasp has been executed; angular execution error is unknown.
The tolerance-envelope protocol is implemented; the 24-pair trial only sampled two offsets (0 and 13.7 mm) and is not a tolerance grid.
The physical fixture ground truth has not been measured with a caliper or guide.

limitations: Rotation tolerance (2 deg) is still a provisional gate; the envelope swept translation only.
The envelope used two trials per offset point in one session; the boundary between 6 and 12 mm in y is bracketed, not resolved.
Still partial: grasp execution, gripper placement and object-fixture pose are unmeasured as separate sources.
Repeatability and backlash are hardware maxima over one session, treated as bounds like the calibration terms.
The fiducial term comes from a composited marker on real frames, not a physically present marker.
